question: My partner and I separated because our relationship broke down. Do I report myself as separated to CRA after just one month apart?

This means that you and your partner are no longer a couple, and you are living independently from each other. You are considered to be separated even if you have not yet filed for a formal divorce or separation agreement, as long as your relationship has broken down and you are living separately.
